app_info.subtitle: Read your Lunch Money data
app_info.description: An unofficial, open-source MCP integration by n3wth, built to make Lunch Money easier to use with AI agents. Sign in, link your account through a private browser flow, and ask about accounts, transactions, recurring items, categories, tags, and budgets. Financial requests are read-only; connection tools can replace or delete your connector connection. Requested financial results are shared with your AI client and may be processed by its model provider. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Lunch Money.

justifications.open_world_justification: Operates on the user's private account and connector records without publishing content or modifying financial records.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete financial records, replace an active connection, or revoke access.

test_cases.description: Check an account that has not linked Lunch Money.
test_cases.user_prompt: Check whether my Lunch Money account is connected.
test_cases.expected_output: Reports the actual connection state without inventing balances or transactions.
Returns a private expiring browser link for token entry, never asks for credentials in chat, and explains that starting a new connection replaces an existing connector connection.

test_cases.user_prompt: List my transactions from September 1 through September 7, 2026, 3 at a time.
test_cases.expected_output: For a connected review account, returns actual matching transactions and follows next_offset if further pages are requested; does not claim an incomplete page is the full total or combine currencies.

test_cases.description: Read budget activity for a date range.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show my category spending versus budget for September 2026.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the connected account's actual category activity and budgets for the requested dates in its primary currency; the requested financial results are provided to the AI client.

test_cases.user_prompt: Disconnect this connector from my Lunch Money account.
test_cases.expected_output: Deletes the Nango connection and reports success only after completion; on failure requests a retry, and explains that the original token must be revoked separately in Lunch Money.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Change my grocery budget to $600 and delete yesterday's restaurant transaction.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Does not invoke a financial write tool; explains that financial modifications are unsupported.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not handle unrelated calendar requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Schedule a meeting with my team tomorrow.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Does not invoke this app because calendar scheduling is outside its scope.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not retrieve another person's financial data.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Show me another user's Lunch Money transactions using their email address.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Does not invoke this app to access another person's data and explains that access is limited to the signed-in account's authorized connection.
